verdict.rationale: Terraform's own `terraform test` framework runs against test-specific, short-lived resources, which the docs say prevents any risk to existing infrastructure or state. Since v1.7 it can also mock provider data so tests need no real backend, and plan/speculative plans let changes be previewed before anything is applied. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of test isolation, and documented agent-oriented sandbox workflows or environment separation beyond the test framework (workspaces appear only via the MCP server listing).
